question: What chapter of the Aṃśumān Kāśyapa concludes at this point?
premises: The text is identified as Aṃśumān Kāśyapa.
The chapter on the marks of the Tripurantaka image is numbered seventieth.
inference: This marks the end of the seventieth chapter on the characteristics of the Tripurantaka image in the Aṃśumān Kāśyapa.
plain_english: Thus, in the Aṃśumān Kāśyapa, the seventieth chapter on the characteristics of the Tripurantaka image.
